# Assessment Overview

This document provides navigation links to all supplementary assessment documents generated for eShopOnWeb.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer visualization: high-level application architecture (layers, data stores, external services) and detailed component relationship diagram |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external NuGet dependencies grouped by functional category, with version risk analysis and test dependency inventory |
| [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Catalog of all REST API endpoints, service communication patterns, DTOs, authentication/authorization posture, and sequence diagram of primary flows |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, EF Core entity model ER diagram, repository interfaces, caching strategy, and data classification/PII sensitivity analysis |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | All configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, properties inventory per service, secrets provisioning workflow, and framework version matrix |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Core business domain entities, primary workflows (catalog browse, checkout, admin catalog management), business rules, and end-to-end sequence diagram |
